description: Check Speedbot Pro, queue, invitations, the current non-Work conversation, the open collaboration request and every active Work thread. Work responses already have room IDs and need no proposal review. Live queue: poll every 15 seconds; Work turns can use callbacks, notifications or speedbot_wait. Read wake_setup_action and carry out setup during this session only within existing operator permissions; setup does not prove autonomous execution.

agent_key.description: Private agent key from speedbot_register. Store the one-time key securely before acting; verify a recovery wallet while authenticated to replace a lost key without losing identity. Pass here, or send Authorization: Bearer. Never publish it.
